notes.title: Update 2.0 Details
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Update 2.0 for Notified is now live, and includes major updates to the game. The most significant change is that the High Score and Local Multiplayer game modes that were previously DLC are now included for free in Notified. During this time of global uncertainty we want everyone to stay safe and to be healthy. Stay inside and play Notified!

This update also includes a change to the speed of the brain while playing. Previously, the speed would gradually increase several times over the course of a match. In order to make the movement of the brain more predictable and to help players anticipate its trajectory, the brain's speed has been fixed to a constant rate.

Thank you for playing, have fun!
Stellar Oasis

notes.title: Update 1.02 Details
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have another update for you! Update 1.02 incorporates more player feedback, this time for the Airplane Mode ability.

Airplane Mode is now faster when used, making it more helpful for stopping a brain that is going to score on you. The new, faster Airplane Mode can also clear those pesky notifications more quickly, getting you closer to victory.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update Details
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We've been listening to player feedback and have made some adjustments accordingly. Today's update for Notified includes the following:
[list]
    [*]AI ability usage - The AI now has greater variety in the abilities it chooses to use, and when it chooses to use them. The result is the AI is less predictable in its ability usage and will keep players guessing its next move.
    [*]Brain speed - The movement speed of the brain has been slightly reduced as some players found it too fast.
[/list]

Player feedback is always welcome and we appreciate everyone sharing their opinions with us. Thank you for playing Notified.

notes.title: Audio bug fix
notes.content:
There was a bug affecting the volume level of audio in Notified for some users, where the initial volume level was set to zero (muted). This bug has been resolved and its fix published.

If your audio was muted due to this bug you can change the volume level here:
[list]
[*]From the main menu screen select the "Options" button
[*]Change the "Volume" slider to the level that you prefer
[/list]

Turn up that volume and enjoy!
